extraction_notes: Fiscal Deficit and Primary Deficit are reported as positive magnitudes as per instructions, although the report shows them as negative (deficit) or positive (surplus). Audit paras raised this year, outstanding over 5 years, and PAC recommendations pending were not explicitly stated as numerical counts. Money value of observations is a sum of outstanding DCC Bills (10.06 crore, page 12) and outstanding Utilisation Certificates (34.72 crore, page 13).
